{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.00
|gr1= DLC

|descr= Returns true if the DLC (CDLC included) is marked as available on Steam.
Official and Creator DLC appIds can be found on [[:Category:Arma 3: DLCs & Expansions|Arma 3: DLCs & Expansions]] and [[:Category:Arma 3: CDLCs|Arma 3: CDLCs]] pages.
{{Feature|important|This command will return [[true]] if the DLC is owned, even if it is '''not''' installed!}}

|s1= [[isDLCAvailable]] appId

|p1= appId : [[Number]]

|r1= [[Boolean]]

|x1= <sqf>
private _karts = 288520;
isDLCAvailable _karts; // returns true
</sqf>

|seealso= [[getDLCs]] [[getObjectDLC]] [[getPersonUsedDLCs]] [[getMissionDLCs]]
}}

{{Note
|user= Benargee
|timestamp= 20141019023900
|text= appId can be taken from Steam DLC url, e.g Karts url is {{hl|<nowiki>http://store.</nowiki>steampowered.com/app/'''288520'''/}}.
}}
